title: Run summary
description: What a skill reports at the end of a non-interactive run (claude -p) so a caller such as a CLI can show the diff, build, and verify without reading prose. One JSON object per run.

skill.description: Skill name without namespace, e.g. setup, add-feature, push-setup.

status.description: completed: work done. needs_input: stopped before changing anything that depends on an answer (see questions). failed: could not finish (see reason). declined: request is outside the plugin's scope or would need an unverifiable API (see reason).

project.description: Detection facts the run acted on (core/commands/detect.sh subset).

changes.description: Files the run created, modified, or deleted, relative to the project root.

steps.description: Ordered steps the skill went through.

apis.description: Sendbird symbols the emitted code uses, each with the source that verifies it (curated doc path, customer SDK cache path, or public URL).

manualSteps.description: What the customer still has to do by hand, e.g. set SENDBIRD_APP_ID or add a capability in Xcode. Empty when nothing is left.

questions.description: What the caller must supply before re-running, when status is needs_input. Each id is the option a caller passes back.

reason.description: Why the run failed or declined.
